home.title: Home
home.description: Service catalogue and project references of Customer Services, generated as slides, HTML, Markdown and Excel without AI.
home.statusBody: This first version contains the base of the application: accounts and roles, settings, audit trail and the interface in English, Spanish and French. References and the catalogue arrive in the next deliveries.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your account and, for administrators, the application configuration, users and audit trail.

account.title: My account
account.description: These preferences are stored with your account and follow you on any computer.

config.title: Configuration
config.description: Functional settings of the application. Every change is applied at once and recorded in the audit trail.
config.infraDescription: Set by IT in the server environment. Read-only here; secrets are masked.

users.title: Users
users.description: Accounts that can sign in. New users receive a temporary password and must change it when they first sign in.
users.tempIntro: Give this password to {{email}}. It is shown only once; the user must change it at first sign-in.
users.deleteBody: This removes {{email}} for good. The audit trail keeps the record of what this user did. Type the email to confirm.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Who did what and when. Passwords and tokens are never recorded.

lists.title: Value lists
lists.description: Values offered by the fields of the app (sectors, IQP, review statuses…). Codes are stable: renaming a label never changes them.
lists.name: Name
lists.systemHint: Used by fields of the app: it cannot be deleted nor change its code.
lists.label: Label
lists.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores (e.g. aerospace).
lists.itemCodeHint: Leave it empty to derive it from the English label.
lists.codeChangeWarning: Changing the code breaks the match with Excel files exported before.
lists.confirmDeleteItemBody: Delete “{{label}}”? It goes to the trash and can be restored. If it is in use, deactivate it instead.
lists.confirmDeleteListBody: Delete the list “{{name}}” and hide its items? It can be restored from the deleted lists.

initialData.description: Loads the value lists and the catalogue V0 taxonomy from the Lists sheet of CS_Reference_Template. It goes through the same analysis and report as any import; running it again changes nothing.
